title: Brew Lane Café

summary: A neighbourhood café serving fresh coffee and daily-baked pastries. This is a fictional demonstration page showing how a QX opens a business.

sections.title: About us
items: Brew Lane is a small independent café. We roast our beans weekly and bake on site every morning.
